column1: #build label(industry_furnaces) start(1; 1) message(A compact furnace block: smelter and kiln on top; wood furnace and glass furnace below. Each is a 3x3 building with one-tile aisles so haulers reach every station. Smelters and kilns need fuel (coke or charcoal) unless you use the magma variants el and en over magma.)
tags: build, furnace, industry, smelting, glass
description: Four core industry furnaces from the furnace family of #build tokens
column2: laid out as a compact 2x2 block with one-tile aisles between them. Top row: es (smelter
column3: turns ore into metal bars) and ek (kiln
column4: fires clay into ceramics and burns wood or bones into ash and bonemeal). Bottom row: ew (wood furnace
column5: burns logs into charcoal fuel) and eg (glass furnace
column6: melts sand into green glass). Each furnace is a full 3x3 footprint
column7: so paint the whole square for every station and keep the aisles clear so haulers can carry ore
column9: and finished bars. Placement rules the blueprint cannot enforce: a smelter
column11: and glass furnace all need fuel
column12: so build a wood furnace or an ashery nearby to make charcoal
column13: or dig down to magma and swap in the magma siblings el (magma smelter) and en (magma kiln)
column14: which need no fuel but must sit over a magma pool. Build this next to your ore and sand stockpiles and near a wood stockpile that feeds the wood furnace.
